name: list-page
summary: The parts list page: saved views with counts, a stock summary strip and a parts grid with bulk actions.
ports: parts: the parts query state (data and phase), typed QueryStateLike with data?: readonly Part[]
viewStore: the saved views store, from createPartViews(parts)
now: the reading time in ms, for countdowns, relative times and the seven-day figure
baseline: last month's stock value and deliveries, for the summary strip deltas
supplierHref: (supplierId) => NavTarget, the supplier link in the supplier column
onReplan: (ids: ReadonlySet<string>, plan: Plan) => void, called on a replan edit or a bulk hold
export createPartViews(parts): the in-memory ViewStore the route passes as viewStore
